source_claim_verbatim_translation: Existence of real zeros of L-functions.
canonical_claim: For a sufficiently large conductor bound Q, among the primitive real Dirichlet characters whose conductors are at most Q, at most one character has a real zero in a source-specified interval immediately to the left of 1; the exact constant, endpoint conventions, and any additional conclusions about the exceptional character or zero must be fixed from the selected source before Lean elaboration.
domain_and_universes: Natural-number conductor cutoff Q; primitive real-valued Dirichlet characters represented at their individual conductors (or by a reviewed equivalent encoding); real beta embedded in C; conclusion in Prop.
ordered_binders_provisional: a conductor cutoff Q above a source-specified threshold
primitive real Dirichlet characters chi with conductor q_chi <= Q
real zeros beta of L(s, chi) in the source-specified near-one region
hypotheses_requiring_statement_freeze: the exact lower threshold on Q
primitivity and the formal meaning of a real character
whether the region is beta > 1 - c / log Q or an equivalent source-normalized region
whether zero endpoints are strict and whether beta is restricted below 1
whether characters are identified as primitive characters or primitive inductions of imprimitive characters
conclusion: The family contains at most one exceptional character/real-zero witness, with any uniqueness, simplicity, or quadraticity refinements included only when supported by the selected exact source statement.
degenerate_cases: Q below the source threshold, modulus 1, the principal character, duplicate encodings of the same primitive character, beta at a region boundary, and characters with no real zero must be handled explicitly in statement mutation tests.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical finite-family reasoning and choice policy remain to be frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel, repository toolchain, and pinned mathlib; exact import and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No numerical zero search, oracle, native computation, or external result is credited at intake
source_revisions: Discovery records are in source-statement-crosswalk.md; no record is H0 evidence.

owners_and_reviewers.reviewer: independent analytic-number-theory and integration-lane review required

freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on changes to the chosen Page-theorem variant, constants or region, character encoding, Lean target, imports/toolchain, source edition, trust policy, or rev-5.6 standard.
status_boundary: A planned intake only: no exact Lean expression, H0, M0, R0, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
